newsitem.title: USA: Essex Intl Inc sets IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: Essex Intl Inc sets IPO terms.

text.p: Essex International Inc set forth terms of its planned initial public offering in a document filed with the U.S. Securities Exchange on Tuesday.
The offering is due to go public on Thursday, April 17, according to lead underwriter Goldman Sachs & Co. Details from the regulatory document follow.
Total shares to be offered 7.5 million

Underwriters over-allotment 1,125,000 shrs Business: Company develops and makes copper electrical wire and cable products. Founded in 1930, it serves over 11,000 worldwide customers from 28 manufacturing facilities and 48 service centers located in the United States and Canada.
